description: Header file defining the VideoDecoder class for Windows platform, including platform-specific video decoding functionalities, HDR support, and threading mechanisms.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: Platform-specific video decoder class for Windows, supporting HDR, threading, and media processing.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VideoDecoder with codec, output mode, graphics context, DRM system, and HDR support.

methods.name: IsHardwareVp9DecoderSupported
methods.description: Checks if hardware VP9 decoder is supported, caches result, not thread-safe on first call.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with status and error callbacks.

methods.name: GetPrerollFrameCount
methods.description: Returns the number of preroll frames.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers to the decoder.

methods.name: TryUpdateOutputForHdrVideo
methods.description: Virtual method to update HDR video output; can be overridden.

methods.name: CreateVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a video frame from a sample.

methods.name: EnsureDecoderThreadRunning
methods.description: Starts decoder thread if not running.

methods.name: DecoderThreadEntry
methods.description: Static entry point for decoder thread.
